children: 1 800 FLOWERS COM INC reported fiscal 2026 net revenues of $1.5B and a net loss of ($134.77M), with diluted loss per share of ($2.11), compared with $1.69B revenue and a net loss of ($199.99M) in fiscal 2025.
¹ Reported as “Net revenues”. ² Reported as “Net loss”. ³ Reported as “Diluted loss per common share”.
Revenue decline reflected a shift in focus toward marketing effectiveness and profitability over near-term top-line growth.
E-commerce sales fell 13.1% as order volume declined about 17.6% while average order value rose 5.5%; wholesale and other channels grew modestly, supported by big-box orders.

By segment, Consumer Floral & Gifts saw the largest drop (approximately (17.7%)), while Gourmet Foods declined more moderately (around (5.2%)) with increased wholesale activity; BloomNet revenues were slightly down.
Management executed leadership changes, digital and marketing modernization, cost-reduction and simplification initiatives to drive a customer‑first, data‑driven transformation.

The company recorded goodwill and intangible-asset impairments primarily in Consumer Floral & Gifts and continued investing in technology and acquisitions, including Scharffen Berger and Card Isle, to broaden offerings.
